skript_probleme: The narration states: "Over time, they refined that total to 241." and "So 441 describes the radio's licensed music, while 241 is where the team's refining of its 900-track plan ended." The source states: "Initially, the team planned to license over 900 tracks for the radio, but over time they refined the total number of tracks to 241." and separately notes: "Grand Theft Auto V has an in-game radio that can tune into sixteen stations playing more than 441 tracks of licensed music". The draft incorrectly presents 241 and 441 as sequential refinement stages of the same list, whereas the source distinguishes the 441 figure as the actual radio content and 241 as a separate, lower figure from the refinement process; they cannot both be the "final" count of the radio.

The narration states: "The tracks are shared between 18 stations". The source states: "The tracks are shared between 18 stations, including two talk radio stations." but the first paragraph of the source states: "Grand Theft Auto V has an in-game radio that can tune into sixteen stations playing more than 441 tracks of licensed music, as well as two talk radio stations." This implies 16 music stations + 2 talk stations = 18 stations total. The draft is internally inconsistent regarding the count, as the introduction states: "The in-game radio has sixteen stations playing more than 441 tracks of licensed music. Two more stations are talk radio."
